name: ai.martechradar/buyer-mcp
title: MarTechRadar Buyer Research
description: Read-only buyer research on AI marketing tools: shortlists, cost comparison, quote and stack checks.

tools.name: decide_martech_stack
tools.description: Shortlist AI marketing tools from the MarTechRadar.ai library (about 1,300 tools) for a stated need, budget and requirements. Prices come from captured vendor pricing pages where available, and each result links to its MarTechRadar page. Supports natural-language queries ("HeyGen vs Synthesia", "cheaper alternative to Clay", "outbound AI SDR 5 seats under $800 HubSpot no lock-in") and structured buyer constraints.

q.description: Natural-language procurement query, tool name, or head-to-head comparison.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Maximum monthly budget ceiling in USD.

noLockIn.description: Exclude tools with annual contract lock-in risk.

noCreditBurn.description: Exclude tools with volatile credit-burn metering.

noSsoTax.description: Exclude tools flagged for gating SAML/SSO behind enterprise tiers.

freeOnly.description: Require a permanent free tier or open-source license.

tools.name: compare_tools_tco
tools.description: Compare two AI marketing tools head-to-head with seat-adjusted Year-1 & 3-Year TCO baselines from published prices, peer price bands for quote-only tools, SSO Tax & lock-in risk flags, and canonical MarTechRadar comparison URL.

slugA.description: First tool slug or name (e.g. "clay" or "heygen").

slugB.description: Second tool slug or name (e.g. "apollo-io" or "synthesia").

usageIntensity.description: Workflow usage intensity for 3-year TCO guidance (default "standard").

tools.name: audit_vendor_quote
tools.description: Red-team a vendor SaaS quote with deterministic 1-year & 3-year compound cost math, subtrack peer P25/Median/P75 comparison, 6-point contract trap scorecard, top 2 BATNA alternatives, and a counter-offer email draft built only from the figures you supply and published prices.

quotedAnnualUsd.description: Quoted annual base software fee in USD.

seats.description: Number of licensed seats in the quote.

ssoAddonUsd.description: Annual SSO / security add-on fee in USD (default 0).

implFeeUsd.description: One-time Year-1 implementation fee in USD (default 0).

clauseNotes.description: Optional non-sensitive contract clause snippets (e.g. auto-renew notice window, credit expiration).

tools.name: audit_current_stack
tools.description: Audit an existing marketing stack for subtrack redundancy, Build-vs-Buy overlap, thin-wrapper (<2.5 moat) and M&A acquisition survival risks, SSO Tax, recent pricing shifts, and consolidation or net-new recommendations.

currentSlugs.description: Current stack tool slugs or anchor names (e.g. ["hubspot-breeze", "clay", "apollo-io"]).

target.description: Optional candidate tool or job-to-be-done being evaluated.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Optional monthly budget cap in USD.
